keys.causal_role: steep rise with counterbalanced scissor silhouette

keys.causal_role: decelerating ascent with silhouette opening before sign change

keys.causal_role: one readable velocity-sign-change sample

keys.causal_role: gravity-earned drop before drag capture

keys.causal_role: independent external-drag task authored during the ongoing fall

keys.causal_role: capture instant transfers force through shoulders while root still descends
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis continues downward-right while a left-biased canopy arrests the shoulders first; unequal tether angles throw the legs into a forward scissor. Capture changes descent slope, not sign.

keys.causal_role: center-of-mass consequence after drag engagement
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis descends one row and swings right beneath the left-biased drag surface; shoulders lag the canopy while the right leg kicks ahead of the root.

keys.causal_role: counterbalanced controlled descent with directional travel
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis continues down-right while the drag surface recenters more slowly; the body hangs on unequal tether angles and the legs counter-swing rather than centering.

keys.causal_role: landing aim while external drag releases before any ground support

keys.causal_role: first authored ground reacquisition through one foot

keys.causal_role: one-foot catch absorbs vertical debt before second support arrives
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Trusted left foot stays planted while pelvis drops/back-shifts and upper body folds; right foot is still airborne.

keys.causal_role: late second-foot support arrival under continuing body consequence

keys.causal_role: deepest center-of-mass absorption after both supports are trustworthy
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis sinks one more row after support is reacquired; arms and head lag forward/down to make force transfer visible.

keys.causal_role: grounded rebound with upper-body overshoot rather than reverse playback

keys.causal_role: secondary lag catches up after pelvis rebound

keys.causal_role: asymmetrical recovery debt retained after the force event

keys.causal_role: return-to-state with translated root and residual stance asymmetry
